end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready and describing festival foods, clothes, decorations, and celebrations. Kavya recalled Baisakhi foods and answered that harvest festivals are linked to crops being ready, but the season connection remained mixed up by the end. At home, use a simple crop-to-season picture or calendar and ask Kavya to match one festival with its harvest and celebration details.
